The Catgirl Manifesto is a shorts series [[Immanuelle]] is doing over December 2022 [[Category:Catgirl Manifesto]][[Category:Shorts]]
[[sn:Catgirl Manifesto]]It represents a shift towards attempting to get virality with shorts, and attempting to enhance viewer retention by developing high quality content. Quality over quantity for this month so that we can later get an enhanced retention for future long term videos. Maybe this series will go viral
==Cancellation==
Series was put on hold due to low viewership and difficulty being consistent in releasing episodes
